evals.prompt: Add tests to an Apps Script order workflow whose functions directly call SpreadsheetApp, Session, Utilities, and MailApp. We need CI without sending email.
evals.expected_output: Minimal dependency seams, pure policy tests, narrow fakes, no real side effects, contract tests, CI commands, and a separate deployment smoke plan.

evals.prompt: Create a regression test plan for a duplicate onFormSubmit incident and an authorization failure that only happens in the deployed web app.
